Your IPO money: five of these nine still lose money. Here's the full list, from India's most famous IPOs.
Paytm. Issue price, two thousand one fifty. Today, sixteen sixty. Down twenty three percent. LIC, down eighteen percent, even after its bonus.
Swiggy. Three ninety at IPO. Now, one seventy seven. Ola Electric. Seventy six at IPO. Now, thirty four. Both down fifty five percent.
And Hyundai, India's biggest IPO ever, is still three percent below. So, did anyone win? Yes. One IPO more than quadrupled.
Policybazaar, up just three percent. Tata Technologies, up thirty one. Nykaa, up eighty seven, counting its bonus shares.
And Zomato, now called Eternal. Seventy six rupees at IPO. Today, three forty four. One lakh became four and a half lakh.
The lesson? Hype is not a business. Getting allotment is luck. What happens next depends on profit and price.
Before your next IPO, check three things. Is it making profit? Is the price high versus peers? And are old owners selling their shares?
